name: Shinobi Legacy
source:
Have you ever wondered what your life would be like in the Naruto universe? A world full of action, pleasure, and above all… insanely sexy kunoichis. 

But what would happen if you suddenly arrived in an alternate reality, where the events you know never happened… or happened in a completely different way? A world where characters who shouldn’t be alive… are alive. A world where characters who shouldn’t even exist… actually exist. 

You will take the role of MC, an ordinary guy who suddenly finds himself thrown into the ninja world. You’ll explore the shinobi life while trying to survive in a world you don’t belong to. 

Here, nothing is easy. You are not the typical protagonist with free, overpowered abilities. You will have to earn your place… prove your courage… or die trying. Will you grow to love this new world… even if it sees you as a criminal? 

Will you find your own ninja path? Will you survive the Shinobi legacy, or will you try to find a way back home? 

The choice is yours.
